crossRefs.note: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to…
from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all…

people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Geber
people.line: Son of Uri; one of Solomon's twelve district governors.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Og
people.line: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

people.name: Uri
people.line: Father of Geber, one of Solomon's officers

translations.web: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.
translations.bsb: Geber son of Uri in the land of Gilead, including the territories of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan. There was also one governor in the land of Judah.
translations.kjv: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.
translations.asv: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer that was in the land.
